dek: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department (LCSD) will present the classical music lecture series "Music at Heart". The eight-lecture series will be held on Wednesdays starting from October 7 at the Lecture Hall of the Hong Kong Space Museum (HKSM), with music educator Calvin Lai as the curator and speaker.
